title: tls left open — review required
description: tls runs with an open setting: tls_disables*=s*1. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply TLS listeners with certificates and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
